scene: A cartoon man in an orange striped shirt sits at a dark table against a light lavender background with red radiating lines above his head.
Two stylized green-and-black banknotes float in the air to the right of the man’s head, one curved upward and one angled downward.
A blank white rectangular paper lies on the table in front of the man’s outstretched right hand.
action: The man’s mouth is wide open, eyes are large and round, and eyebrows are raised, indicating an expression of shock or alarm.
His left arm is raised with fingers splayed; his right arm extends forward toward the paper on the table.
Red pointed shapes radiate outward from the top of his head, suggesting sudden mental stimulation or surprise.
rationale: The open mouth and wide eyes are conventional visual cues for surprise or alarm in cartoon illustration.
Floating banknotes near a startled figure may indicate unexpected financial change, though no causal link is visually confirmed.
The blank paper on the table lacks text or markings, so its purpose cannot be determined from visual evidence alone.
object: The figure has a balding head with dark hair on the sides and back, a prominent nose, and large circular eyes with black pupils.
He wears a short-sleeved orange shirt with horizontal black stripes and a black collar trim.
Two green banknotes with black abstract patterns and small unreadable rectangular markings float to his right.
A white rectangular sheet of paper rests flat on the dark tabletop in front of him.
Seven red triangular spikes with black tips emanate radially from the crown of his head against a pale background.

limitations: No textual labels or contextual setting confirm symbolic intent; interpretation relies on convention rather than explicit evidence.
